text:
alice: rolling a config-only change now to routing + batching params. canary 10% US-east. cfg id cfg-2026-03-20-batchguard.

ben: ack. quick summary of changes?

alice: TL;DR: reduce default tenant concurrency to 30 (non-premium), keep premium pinned at 100; shorten batching target from 30ms -> 20ms for short seqs; route low-qps tenants to slower but cheaper pool if >95th mem pressure. no model change.

ciara: please include rollback criteria and signal set. add :eyes: on perf dashboards: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/batchguard

alice: rollback if p95 latency increases by >50ms over baseline OR error rate >2% sustained for 5m. also abort if tail OOMs spike on any node.

ben: add config snippet for auditing?

alice: sure:```json
{
  "config_id": "cfg-2026-03-20-batchguard",
  "routing": {"pin_premium": true, "default_concurrency": 30, "slow_pool_threshold_qps": 2},
  "batching": {"target_latency_ms": 20, "max_batch_tokens": 512, "kv_cache_prefetch": true}
}
```

deploy-bot: cfg-2026-03-20-batchguard canary started at 2026-03-20T22:13:07Z -> 10% traffic (US-east). monitors: latency,p99,p95,error-rate,cpu,memory.

ciara: monitoring set up. subscribing to ting-ops-alerts and bench-runner.

dave: recommended watchlist: p95 generation, end-to-end tail, tenant teb-42 (previously noisy), router queue length.

deploy-bot: canary completed to 10% after 2m. initial metrics: p95 +15ms (non-premium), error-rate 0.18%. no OOMs.

elaine: running a short synthetic burst against teb-42 now. will report in 3m.

deploy-bot: at 30% traffic now (progressing). metrics trending: overall p95 +30ms, teb-42 p95 +120ms, teb-42 error-rate 1.9% (spikey).

ben: teb-42 is the one we discussed — they have long contexts. maybe batch shrink is hurting them.

alice: holding advance. @deploy-bot pin teb-42 to previous config (vcfg-2026-02-11-default) and stop routing their traffic into the new pool.

deploy-bot: tenant teb-42 pinned to vcfg-2026-02-11-default. traffic for teb-42 re-routed in 30s.

ciara: after pin, teb-42 p95 back to baseline in 45s. other tenants still within thresholds.

dave: good call. we should continue at 30% for another 10m, keep teb-42 pinned, and collect more samples.

alice: agreed. no full rollout until metrics stable for 20m. logging incident for teb-42 behavior. follow-up: create eval with long contexts to see batch window impact.

deploy-bot: current status: canary paused at 30% (manual hold). pinned tenants: [teb-42]. alerts armed for p95>50ms delta and error-rate>1%.

elaine: I'll file a short release note for support + account team: "partial pin for teb-42 due to tail latency on shortened batch window; canary paused at 30%".

alice: thanks. post-mortem if we can't reconcile within next 24h. for now we preserved safety and avoided a global rollback. :thumbsup:

ben: small action items: 1) run bench with 8k seqs + kv cache off, 2) re-run canary with an alternative batch rule that increases target_latency for long contexts, 3) update docs about tenant pinning ops.

ciara: I'll take item 1 & 2. starting bench job now.

alice: excellent. marking thread resolved for the release side — we'll update when we either advance or rollback fully.

deploy-bot: note: audit log entry created: rollout cfg-2026-03-20-batchguard -> paused at 30%, tenant teb-42 pinned. ref #rollout-5054321987.

elaine: ping when bench results are in and we'll coordinate next steps with CS.

end
